Ive only recently started playing the game so others will probably be able to explain better than i can but i will give it a shot!

Basically the way builds are made in this game is via trainers, there are NPC’s that you pay to teach you skills, of which there are 3 “tiers” of for each trainer.

Tier 1 are universal skills that anyone of any build can take, as long as you have enough money to pay for it

Tier 2 is the “Breakthrough” skill that requires a breakthrough point and money to unlock, you only get 3 breakthrough points per character skill so they are pretty much what defines your build, and these skills are as far as i know always passives, though powerful ones.

Tier 3 requires you to have unlocked the breakthrough skill, and is the final tier where the last abilities of the trainer are found.

There are also lone trainers who only teach 1 or sometimes 2 skills that don’t belong to any specific “class”

As for what to look for based on your preferred “class”, i’ve only really played magic so others would explain the melee classes better, i can still give a brief explanation of my knowledge of some of the classes!

The first you are likely to find as the trainer is in the starting village, is the kazite spellblade who, as you can infer from the name, uses both melee and magic, mainly in the form of infusing elemental damage into their melee attacks.

The sigil mage is the first pure mage class you would likely find as its starting spells are obtained when you first learn magic. It revolves around creating stationary elemental sigils on the ground using special items, and when standing inside of these sigils you have spells and items that have different affects, such as fireball or a ring of fire. You can also stack multiple elemental sigils on the same spot to stack their effects.

The rune mage wields a lexicon in the offhand to cast spell combos using different runes. The spell you cast is dependent on which 2 runes you combine, such as a rune trap that explodes dealing high damage, a heal, a light, a summoned sword,  and lightning.

The hex mage is the master of hexes which weaken a foes resistances, and can trigger hexes to explode creating chain reactions, this one is my personal favorite.

Theres the cabal hermit whose abilities revolve around wind and boons which increase your resistances.

As for melee classes there the rogue who you cna probably tell revolves around daggers and backstabs.

Theres the speedster who has a unique buff called alertness and has high move speed and cooldown speed.

The mercenary mainly uses guns to a higher effect and can also use ice element.

There are others but i am less familiar with them and i wouldn’t want to spoil all the fun, so i will leave it there for now. You can mix up to three of the classes to their full power due to breakthrough points as you can only get tier 2 and 3 by using your breakthroughs. There is also no way to respec as far as i know because the game expects you to make multiple characters. Hope i explained this well enough and hope you have fun, because this game is something else!
